steps.objText: Follow the track toward the smoke
Drive the wolves from the goose pen

objectives.text: Read the stone north of the road

offer: A tall stone by the track. Cut square, set on end.
Marks on one face. Too worn to read from here.
active: The stone by the track. Read it up close.
ready: Bridge stone. Pulled down from the west bank.
Behind it, in the grass, ten arrows tied with twine.
done: The stone stands. The river runs where the bridge was.

quests.title: The West Arm

steps.objText: Find the sign arm in the shallows

quests.returnText: Bring the sign arm to the ford post

offer: A tag on the basket: THE WEST ARM OF THE SIGN FELL.
IN THE SHALLOWS BY THE FORD. BRING IT BACK.
active: The tag: WEST ARM. IN THE SHALLOWS.
ready: You lay the arm in the basket. The wood is river-black.
Under it, tied with twine: ten arrows.
done: The tag: WEST POINTS WEST AGAIN. THANK YOU.
